text: Fidelidade's shareholders page lists Fosun Group (through Millennium Gain Limited) with 84.9892% and Caixa Geral de Depósitos (CGD) with 15%, describing CGD as a bank owned by the Portuguese State; the page adds that Fosun International Limited is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange (00656.HK).
short: Fidelidade is 84.9892% Fosun Group and 15% state-owned CGD; Fosun International is HKEX-listed (00656.HK).

source.name: Fidelidade: Shareholders (investor relations page)
source.quote: Fosun Group (through Millennium Gain Limited): 84.9892% ... Caixa Geral de Depósitos (“CGD”): 15% CGD is a bank owned by the Portuguese State.

additionalSources.name: Fosun: About us - company profile
additionalSources.quote: In 2007, Fosun International Limited was listed on the main board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (stock code: 00656.HK).

additionalSources.name: Macquarie Asset Management press release: 'Macquarie Asset Management to acquire Luz Saúde stake'
additionalSources.quote: Macquarie Asset Management, via Macquarie European Infrastructure Fund 7, has reached an agreement to acquire a 40 per cent stake in Luz Saúde ... The stake will be acquired from Fidelidade, the leading insurance company in Portugal, who will retain a 60 per cent stake in the company.
additionalSources.note: Establishes the chain from Hospital da Luz's operator Luz Saúde up to Fidelidade (60%, with Macquarie European Infrastructure Fund 7 at 40% since Sep 2025).
